## Introduction

This R Markdown document is part of Practice Assignment 1 for the ST2195 Programming for Data Science course.

The purpose of this exercise is to print all integers from 1 to 10 using R.

## R Code

The following R code prints the integers from 1 to 10.

```{r}
# Print integers from 1 to 10
print(1:10)
```

## Conclusion

The code successfully prints all integers from 1 to 10.
